items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: The mention of Malcolm is in the [INTERVIEWER] turn ('I used to go there to see Pigmeat and Malcolm'). The [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of meeting Malcolm.

ctx.x: Time y'all was going up there.

Yeah, I caught him every week. I used to go there to see Pigmeat and Malcolm. Yeah, Pigmeat and Ralph Cooper. Yeah, Ralph Cooper, yeah. Somebody basket, another comedian there. And I caught a cab band at the Lowest State downtown. I caught a, well, Daniel Bach was playing with Lucky Mill and the other. Oh, yeah. That was good. I could be used to go to Danny's house, you know, whenever we hit you, you know. I don't know where that was. I don't know where that was. We took it and put it in the book somewhere to…
Oh, sorry. Sorry, that's so much stuff.
